newsitem.title: UK: Lloyds Chemists current sales up 4 percent.
newsitem.headline: Lloyds Chemists current sales up 4 percent.

text.p: Pharmacy and retailing group Lloyds Chemist Plc said on Wednesday sales at its chemists division rose four percent in the 13 weeks to September 28 and were also four percent up on a like for like basis.

Sales at its Holland & Barrett healthfood shops rose 19 percent overall and eight percent on a like for like basis. Health and Beauty sales rose by two percent in total but fell one percent after stripping out new space.
The group's veterinary division had growth of 21 percent, but its pharmaceutical business increased external sales by 11 percent.
The group reported pretax profits for the year to June 30 of 47.0 million stg, down from 55.6 million in the previous year.

In July Lloyds warned that second half profits would be lower than in the first half due to uncertainty over the referral of rival takeover bids for it from Gehe AG and UniChem Plc to Britain's competition watchdog the Monopolies and Mergers Commission.
